justification: Changes what file size the DCP monitor records and when it re-downloads; change detection by tag and hash is unchanged.

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_chapter_registry row 766 (ku_ring_gai) url_content_length=1 after force run 3 recorded unchanged_hash; row 257 the same on 2026-09-01. 1 of 571 active rows is below 1000 bytes; 31 hold NULL.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The writer assumed a server's reported size is the file's size; Ku-ring-gai's server reports 1 for a real PDF (the download passed the 1000-byte PDF check, so the 1 came from HEAD).
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reuses MIN_PDF_BYTES as the floor; one helper and one download reason added.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a reported size under 1000 bytes is stored, or a stored impossible size is never re-measured
falsifiable_check.observed_red: 9 hand mutants killed (5 on plausible_size and its two writers, 4 on the size_impossible rule); one survived a first draft (second writer reverted) and the test was tightened.

functions.name: plausible_size
functions.input: a server's reported size as text or number
functions.output: the size as an int, or None below MIN_PDF_BYTES
functions.if_none: missing or unparseable input returns None so the writer uses the downloaded length

functions.name: decide_fetch
functions.input: stored and HEAD tags and sizes, last download time, spot flag
functions.output: whether to download today and why, now including size_impossible
functions.if_none: a NULL stored size is unknown, not impossible, and does not force a download

break_it.scenario: A server answers HEAD for a real PDF with Content-Length 1 (Ku-ring-gai)
break_it.what_happens: silent: url_content_length = 1 stored, DQ-79 red, gates blocked for every PR
break_it.how: sizes under 1000 bytes are unknown; the downloaded length is stored

break_it.scenario: A row already holds 1 byte behind a matching ETag
break_it.what_happens: never re-downloaded, so the wrong size stays for ever
break_it.how: decide_fetch downloads once with reason size_impossible

break_it.scenario: 31 active rows have no recorded size (NULL)
break_it.what_happens: a careless rule would download them every day
break_it.how: NULL is unknown, not impossible; the rule needs a stored number

break_it.scenario: An error page replaces the PDF under the same ETag, HEAD size 500
break_it.what_happens: silent if the tiny size were ignored everywhere: no download, no body check
break_it.how: the raw size still drives decide_fetch, only storage ignores it (Sol)

post_merge.db_reset: None: no schema change; row 766 is corrected by the next daily run's own download.
post_merge.manual_verify: After the next daily run: dcp_chapter_registry id 766 url_content_length > 1000 and python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-79 reads 0.
